# AP242 geometry coverage

<!-- Generated by scripts/check_coverage.py; edit docs/coverage.json. -->

Every instantiable subtype of `GEOMETRIC_REPRESENTATION_ITEM`, `TOPOLOGICAL_REPRESENTATION_ITEM`, `SHAPE_REPRESENTATION` in the pinned AP242 MIM long form (SHA-256 `e7e93cf97880fd87…`), classified as: **adapted** (declared by an import profile and covered by `scripts/check_geometry.py`), **supertype** (declared by a profile only as a supertype; a direct instance is rejected as outside the profile), **product** (evaluated by the product adapter as a placement, not as geometry), **unsupported** (a named, typed rejection: the import names the entity as outside the selected profile) or **out_of_scope** (a recorded decision). Structural schema validation of these entities is separate; see [corpus-testing.md](corpus-testing.md#ap-schema-stage-milestone-21).
